_comment: The practice sources in force in this repository. Precedent is its own
consumer: the universal set it publishes is the set it runs on.
A shared repository may declare universal and team sources ONLY -- a
person's individual set is declared in their own user-level config, so
that naming it here cannot leak its existence to everyone on the team.
See tools/precedent_resolve.py for the resolution and precedence rules.
The team source below is real: precedent-team-maintainers IS this
repo's own maintaining team's conventions (Morgan and Alex). Declared
2026-09-02 by the phase-5 deep-check follow-up -- see
spec/PHASE5_DEEPCHECK.md's 'wiring precedent-team-maintainers into
BestPractice' note for what this does and does not change: it makes
precedent_resolve.py (run from a checkout with a sibling clone of that
repo, or precedent_materialize.py against a real checkout) correctly
resolve this repo's own real team source, for the first time -- it
does NOT change this repo's own generated AGENTS.md/MAP.md/GLOSSARY.md
(build_views.py deliberately stays single-source: this repo's own
session-loading is the universal catalogue alone, same as before).
The repo-local source below (declared 2026-09-03, after the PR #89
merge-target incident) is this repo's own temporary practice: every
PR targets precedent-beta-v01, never main, until Alex reviews and
merges precedent-beta-v01 for real. Per the same single-source note
above, this does NOT reach AGENTS.md's generated loader block either
-- AGENTS.md's hand-authored 'Working in this repo' section carries
the rule directly for that reason. See local/practices/ and
PRACTICE_ENGINE_PLAN.md's 'Source' section for the path: "local"
convention this follows.
